about_hero.label: WHY CHOOSE FOLKS?
about_hero.subtitle: FOLKS is here to prove that every child can be fluent in English.
about_hero.desc: We believe that the right learning environment is the key to success. With fun methods and experienced teachers, FOLKS Institute guides every student to grow in confidence — from elementary to high school.

about_story.title: Our Story
about_story.highlight: FOLKS Institute was born from a simple vision: to make English no longer a barrier, but a bridge to your academic and professional dreams. We realize that every individual has a different starting line and goal, from just wanting to be fluent and confident in daily conversation, to the ambition of entering global universities and institutions with high IELTS, TOEFL, or TOEIC scores.
about_story.desc: Therefore, we design a comprehensive learning ecosystem. We don't just focus on rigid grammar theory, but on real practice, test strategy breakdown, and intensive simulations. Supported by experienced teachers, FOLKS Institute is committed to continuing to accompany your every step — turning doubt into fluency, and target scores into reality.

faqItems.q: How do I enroll my child?
faqItems.a: Registration can be done directly via the 'Enroll Now' button on our website or by visiting the nearest branch for a free consultation.

faqItems.q: What teaching method is used?
faqItems.a: We use the 'Interactive Narrative' method where children learn through stories involving Folks characters in an active two-way environment.

faqItems.q: Is there a placement test before joining?
faqItems.a: Yes, we provide a fun trial session and short assessment to ensure children are placed in a class that suits their abilities.

faqItems.q: What is the maximum number of students in a class?
faqItems.a: To maintain interaction quality, each class is limited to a maximum of 8-10 students.

features.desc: Structured progression from CEFR B1 (Intermediate) up to C2 (Mastery), ensuring your fluency constantly evolves.

faqItems.q: Is this program suitable for beginners?
faqItems.a: This program is recommended for participants who already have a basic understanding of English (minimum A2/B1 level) and want to focus on speaking fluency.

faqItems.q: How many students are in a Conversation class?
faqItems.a: To maximize speaking time for each participant, classes are limited to a maximum of 6-8 people.

faqItems.q: Is grammar taught too?
faqItems.a: Grammar is taught contextually through direct feedback while practicing speaking, rather than through written theory.

faqItems.q: How do I know my current speaking level?
faqItems.a: We will conduct a short speaking assessment at the beginning to place you in the most appropriate class.

features.title: Career Advancement

faqItems.q: What industries are available?
faqItems.a: We cater to various fields including IT, Medical, Legal, Hospitality, Aviation, and Engineering. You can consult for other specific needs.

faqItems.q: Is this a private or group class?
faqItems.a: We offer private classes as well as in-house training for companies (small groups from the same industry).

faqItems.q: How long is the ESP program?
faqItems.a: The duration is highly flexible depending on your goals and the complexity of the material, typically ranging from 3 to 6 months.

faqItems.q: Who are the instructors?
faqItems.a: The instructors are professional English teachers with understanding or background in the relevant industry.

features.title: C-Level Proficiency

faqItems.q: Is this program suitable for fresh graduates?
faqItems.a: This program is more aimed at mid-level professionals to executives who already have work experience and want to elevate their business communication level.

faqItems.q: Is it available for corporate training?
faqItems.a: Absolutely. We provide B2B Corporate Training packages tailored to your company's strategic goals.

faqItems.q: How does the material differ from ESP?
faqItems.a: ESP focuses on technical vocabulary for a specific industry (e.g., medical/IT), while Professional Business focuses on managerial communication, negotiation, and cross-industry leadership skills.

faqItems.q: Is the schedule flexible?
faqItems.a: Yes, we understand the busy lives of professionals, so schedules can be adjusted to your availability.
